fields.body: Inspected the area. Water is leaking from joint on main supply pipe. Will require pipe replacement. Parts ordered.
Parts have arrived. Tech1 will complete repair tomorrow morning.
Access point in Block B has firmware issue. Downloading update now. Will test connectivity after reboot.
PABX card fault confirmed. Supplier has been contacted. Estimated delivery 3-5 working days.
Please expedite this — the Finance department is unable to communicate internally.
Working with the DBA. The ORA-01017 error is an authentication issue with the HR module schema user. Reset in progress.
Account has been unlocked. Temporary password sent via SMS. Please change on next login.
ISP has acknowledged the outage. PABX trunk card failed. Awaiting engineer visit.
Escalated to HOD level. Emergency procurement of 4G backup link being explored while ISP fixes main fibre.

fields.comment: Very quick response and the issue was fixed properly. Satisfied with the service.
Account unlocked quickly. Would have preferred a heads-up before the lock-out.
Critical payroll issue resolved before the deadline. Excellent work by the ICT team.
Arrears were correctly processed. Appreciated the follow-up from the payroll team.
Vehicle arranged promptly and trip was smooth. Great coordination.
Took a bit long but the fix was solid. Acceptable outcome.
Files found quickly and delivered same day. Very professional service.
